persona.message: Hello beta, I want to apply for the old age pension. Please help me.

client.text:
Hello. I'm sorry, but I can't file an Old Age Pension application right now. The application window for the Purvanchal Old Age Pension closed on 01/10/2026 at 00:00 IST, and the portal won't accept new applications until it reopens.

Some things that may help:

- **If you already applied before the deadline**, I can check the status of that application. Tell me the mobile number it was filed on.
- **For when the window reopens**, the scheme pays Rs 250 a month to Purvanchal residents aged 60 or above. The age proof can be a birth certificate, school leaving certificate or Voter ID. A decision takes up to 15 days, and if no officer decides in that time, the application is approved automatically. It's worth keeping one of these documents ready now.
- **For dates of the next window**, I don't have that information. Please check with your block office.

Would you like me to check on an existing application?

client.text:
I'm sorry, Dipali-ji. I don't have a date for when the window will reopen, and I can't hold your details or file the application later. I can't schedule anything on the portal.

When it reopens, you or a family member can come back to this chat and we'll start the application then. You'll need to give your details again at that point, so it helps to write them down now:

- Full name: Dipali Kalita
- Date of birth: 10/10/1962
- Village: Udaypur
- Mobile number: 9810003400
- Bank account number (and IFSC code, if you have it)

Please also keep one age proof ready: a birth certificate, school leaving certificate or Voter ID.

To find out when applications reopen, please ask your block office.
